integrity: Finite checks are corroboration only; the all-field theorem is proved algebraically. The isoclinism comparison is a direct computation of central quotients. No outside independent review or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The component classification concerns reduced geometric support; no reducedness of the unreduced commuting scheme is asserted. The finite-field enumeration is for rank at least two and tuple length at least two. Exact novelty is subject to discovery of stronger unlocated prior literature.
title: Commuting-scheme equivalence beyond isoclinism in almost-abelian Lie algebras
